summary: 8/8 UI-facing criteria covered with 8 passing browser checks; 3 backend test files (5 test cases) covering the API-bearing criteria all pass. No bugs found.

checks.criterion: Úvodní stránka se načte bez chyb v konzoli a bez requestů se statusem >= 400
checks.name: homepage-loads-clean
checks.evidence: Hero visible with hero-cta-book-button, hero-secondary-wizard-button, and 'Ideáln' text; no response >=400 observed during load.

checks.criterion: Ceník se načítá z /api/services a zobrazuje řádky služeb
checks.name: pricing-list-loads-services

checks.criterion: Ceník se načítá z /api/services a zobrazuje řádky služeb
checks.name: test_services_endpoint_returns_seeded_services
checks.evidence: GET /api/services -> 200, returned 5 seeded services (klasicka-manikura, gel-lak, modelaz-nehtu, nail-art, pedikura) each with name/description/price(Kč)/duration_min.

checks.criterion: Kliknutí na service-select-btn-<id> předvybere službu a přeskočí na krok 2 (Termín)
checks.name: service-select-jumps-to-step2
checks.evidence: After clicking service-select-btn-*, booking-step-date-picker became visible and #rezervace scrolled into viewport.

checks.name: booking-e2e-flow
checks.evidence: Selected service -> found open weekday with an enabled slot-button-* -> filled name/phone -> booking-success-confirmation became visible.

checks.name: test_create_booking_end_to_end / test_availability_closed_on_sunday
checks.evidence: POST /api/bookings -> 200 with persisted booking (calendar_synced=false as expected per spec deviation); GET /api/bookings/{id} confirms persistence; duplicate slot POST -> 409; GET /api/availability on a Sunday -> closed=true, all slots unavailable.

checks.name: chat-klara-answers-price
checks.evidence: hero-cta-book-button opens chat-window; POST /api/chat for 'Kolik stoji gel lak?' returned 200 with reply 'Gel lak stojí 650 Kč...'; chat-bubble-assistant rendered.

checks.name: test_chat_returns_price_answer / test_chat_history_is_retrievable
checks.evidence: POST /api/chat -> 200 non-empty reply string mentioning Kč; GET /api/chat/{session_id} -> turns array with >=2 entries.

checks.criterion: AI studio náhled reaguje na volby
checks.name: ai-studio-preview-options-toggle
checks.evidence: Clicking an inactive shape-option-*, finish-option-*, length-option-* each changed the button's class (active style applied).

checks.name: gallery-photos-load-and-header-scrolls
checks.evidence: gallery-photo-1..4 img elements all had naturalWidth > 0; site-header backgroundColor changed from transparent after scrolling 1200px.

checks.name: mobile-responsive-no-horizontal-scroll
checks.evidence: At 390x844, document.scrollWidth (390) <= window.innerWidth (390) + 2; hero-cta-book-button visible and enabled.

notes: spec_deviations honored: calendar_synced=false / calendar not configured is expected, not a bug.
'neprázdným polem reply' in the criterion means a non-empty reply FIELD (Czech 'pole'=field), not an array — /api/chat returns reply as a string; verified accordingly.
